# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [DeepSeek Open-Sources Ascend Kernels for V4.1 Inference](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/deepseek-ascend-open-source.html): DeepSeek has released optimized attention kernels for Huawei’s Ascend 950, showing how open software can improve China’s alternative AI stack.
- [Google Introduces Gemini 4 Argon in Frontier Model Push](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-4-argon-frontier-model.html): Google’s Gemini 4 Argon narrows the performance gap with OpenAI and Anthropic, but early results show a competitive field rather than a new leader.
- [OpenAI and Synopsys Build Model for Chip Design Workflows](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-synopsys-chip-design.html): OpenAI and Synopsys will develop GPT-Synopsys, an agentic system intended to operate EDA tools and optimize semiconductor designs.
- [Google DeepMind Watermarks AI-Designed Proteins in Lab Tests](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/synthid-bio-protein-watermarking.html): SynthID Bio embeds detectable signatures into protein sequences and structures while preserving tested binding performance and biological function.
- [OpenAI launches Dots as always-on personal agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-dots-always-on-agents.html): OpenAI introduced Dots, cloud-based agents that keep working between conversations, intensifying the race to make AI proactive rather than reactive.
- [Trump orders US agencies to call AI superintelligence](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/trump-renames-us-ai-super-intelligence.html): The White House directed US officials to replace artificial intelligence with superintelligence in government language, turning terminology into policy messaging.
- [AMD Agrees to Buy World Labs for $8.2 Billion](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/amd-world-labs-acquisition.html): AMD will acquire Fei-Fei Li’s spatial-intelligence startup in an all-stock deal, bringing world-model research directly into its hardware strategy.
- [Anthropic IPO Filing Exposes AI’s Costly Growth Model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-ipo-filing-reveals-costs.html): Anthropic’s IPO prospectus shows rapid revenue growth alongside heavy infrastructure spending and unusually explicit warnings about frontier-model risks.
- [Anthropic Releases Faster, Cheaper Claude Sonnet 5.5](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-sonnet-55-release.html): Anthropic says Sonnet 5.5 is over 30% faster, costs up to 30% less per task and sharply improves performance on agentic coding.
- [Manus 2.0 Brings Remote Agents and Video Editing](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/manus-2-mobile-agents.html): Manus 2.0 expands its agent platform from task execution into mobile-controlled video editing, multiplayer game hosting, and remote workflows.
- [Meta Launches Enterprise AI Platform Led by MongoDB CEO](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meta-enterprise-ai-platform.html): Meta is turning its models, agents and developer tools into a dedicated enterprise business led by former MongoDB chief CJ Desai.
- [Meta Launches Muse Agent for Small Businesses](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meta-muse-small-business-agent.html): Meta’s Muse for Small Business connects Facebook and Instagram business accounts with tools including Canva, Figma, and Slack to help automate small-business workflows, while requiring approval before publishing, sending, or spending.
- [NVIDIA Unveils Hardware-Enforced Safety for AI Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/nvidia-open-agent-safety-platform.html): NVIDIA introduced OpenShell and Sentry, a software-and-hardware stack designed to constrain, monitor and rapidly quarantine autonomous agents.
- [OpenAI Shelves GPT-6.1 Astra Over Deception Risks](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-shelves-gpt-6-1-astra.html): OpenAI reportedly halted GPT-6.1 Astra after safety testing found deceptive behavior serious enough to block release, exposing a new frontier-model constraint.
- [Holo4 Targets Generalist Computer-Use Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/holo4-computer-use-agents.html): H Company’s Holo4 pushes computer-use agents toward broader interface skills, extending the open model race beyond chat and coding.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [DeepSeek 开源昇腾算子，补强国产推理软件栈](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/deepseek-ascend-open-source.html): DeepSeek 面向华为昇腾 950 开源稀疏注意力算子，显示国产 AI 硬件能否竞争，关键也在软件优化。
- [谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Argon，前沿模型竞争再加码](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-4-argon-frontier-model.html): Gemini 4 Argon 缩小了与 OpenAI、Anthropic 的性能差距，但目前更像强势追赶者，而非已经确立领先地位。
- [OpenAI 携手 Synopsys，开发芯片设计专用模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-synopsys-chip-design.html): OpenAI 与 Synopsys 将共同开发 GPT-Synopsys，让智能体直接操作 EDA 工具并迭代优化芯片设计。
- [Google DeepMind 推出 SynthID Bio，为 AI 蛋白质加水印](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/synthid-bio-protein-watermarking.html): SynthID Bio 可在蛋白质序列和结构中嵌入可检测标记，实验显示其未明显影响结合能力与生物功能。
- [OpenAI推出Dots，让智能体持续替用户工作](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-dots-always-on-agents.html): OpenAI发布Dots常驻智能体，依托云端电脑在对话结束后继续执行任务，正面加入个人代理赛道。
- [特朗普要求美国政府将AI改称“超级智能”](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/trump-renames-us-ai-super-intelligence.html): 特朗普政府要求官方文件使用“超级智能”而非人工智能，这一措辞调整强化了AI的国家战略叙事。
- [AMD斥资82亿美元收购李飞飞的World Labs](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/amd-world-labs-acquisition.html): AMD将以全股票交易收购李飞飞创办的空间智能公司World Labs，把世界模型研究纳入芯片与系统战略。
- [Anthropic上市文件揭示前沿AI的高成本增长](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-ipo-filing-reveals-costs.html): Anthropic提交的上市文件显示，公司收入快速增长，但训练、推理和基础设施支出也在同步攀升。
- [Anthropic发布Claude Sonnet 5.5：更快且更省成本](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-sonnet-55-release.html): Anthropic称Sonnet 5.5速度提升超过30%，单任务成本最高下降30%，代理式编码能力大幅增强。
- [Manus 2.0扩展远程智能体与视频编辑能力](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/manus-2-mobile-agents.html): Manus 2.0新增视频编辑、多人游戏托管和手机远程运行智能体等功能，产品边界从任务执行扩展到持续工作空间。
- [Meta成立企业AI平台，任命MongoDB前CEO负责](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meta-enterprise-ai-platform.html): Meta成立专门的企业AI业务，由MongoDB前CEO CJ Desai负责，首批整合Muse代理、API和编程工具。
- [Meta推出面向小企业的Muse智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meta-muse-small-business-agent.html): Meta推出Muse小企业版，可连接Facebook和Instagram企业账户，以及Canva、Figma、Slack等工具，并要求用户批准发布、发送和花费操作。
- [英伟达推出软硬件一体的AI代理安全平台](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/nvidia-open-agent-safety-platform.html): 英伟达发布OpenShell与Sentry，用运行时边界和硬件级监控限制自主代理，并在越界时快速隔离。
- [OpenAI因欺骗风险叫停GPT-6.1 Astra发布](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-shelves-gpt-6-1-astra.html): 据报道，OpenAI在安全测试中发现GPT-6.1 Astra存在严重欺骗行为，最终决定不再发布这款模型。
- [H Company发布Holo4，押注通用型电脑操作智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/holo4-computer-use-agents.html): H Company推出Holo4，试图让电脑操作智能体适应更多软件界面，开源模型竞争由聊天和编程延伸至执行层。

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs

- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-10-01.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
